title.id: Update visa pelajar November 2026: 6 perubahan penting di Australia, NZ, Inggris, Kanada & AS
title.en: Student visa update November 2026: 6 key changes in Australia, NZ, UK, Canada & the US

description.id: Ringkasan resmi: konsultasi Genuine Student & bukti dana Australia, visa kerja lulusan baru NZ, dana hidup UK naik 30 Nov 2026, target pelajar Kanada 2027-2029, dan status D/S AS.
description.en: Official roundup: Australia's Genuine Student & financial capacity consultation, NZ's new graduate work visa, UK maintenance funds rising on 30 Nov 2026, Canada's 2027-2029 student targets and the US D/S ruling.

body.id:
Bulan ini ada beberapa perubahan resmi (dan satu konsultasi publik) yang penting bagi siswa Indonesia yang merencanakan studi di luar negeri tahun 2027. Semua poin di bawah diambil dari situs pemerintah - link ada di bagian Sumber.

1. Australia: konsultasi reformasi Genuine Student & bukti dana Konsultasi publik

Home Affairs membuka konsultasi (tutup 23 November 2026) tentang: pembaruan Ministerial Direction 106 untuk penilaian Genuine Student, penguatan syarat bukti dana (financial capacity), dan kemungkinan langkah sementara untuk pemohon dari negara Evidence Level 3. Belum ada keputusan - aturan saat ini tetap berlaku.

Artinya untuk Anda: siapkan dokumen dana yang rapi dan alasan studi yang jelas sejak awal. Simulasi rekening koran minimum per program sudah tersedia di pricelist Talented.

2. Selandia Baru: Short-Term Graduate Work Visa (6 bulan) Berlaku

Mulai 16 November 2026, lulusan kualifikasi NZQCF Level 5-7 (minimal 24 minggu full-time di NZ) yang tidak memenuhi syarat Post-Study Work Visa bisa mendapat 6 bulan izin kerja terbuka. Ajukan paling lambat 3 bulan setelah visa pelajar berakhir dan siapkan dana hidup NZD 5.000.

3. Selandia Baru: Post-Study Work Visa diperluas Berlaku

Juga mulai 16 November 2026: lulusan Graduate Diploma Level 7 yang sudah memiliki gelar sarjana (dari NZ atau luar negeri) bisa mendapat PSWV hingga 1 tahun. Postgraduate Diploma (Level 8) hingga 1 tahun dan Master (Level 9) hingga 3 tahun, dengan minimal 30 minggu studi full-time di NZ.

4. Inggris: dana hidup minimum naik 30 November 2026 Akan berlaku

Untuk aplikasi visa Student mulai 30 November 2026: London GBP 1.570/bulan (maks. 9 bulan = GBP 14.130) dan luar London GBP 1.203/bulan (maks. GBP 10.827). Dana harus mengendap minimal 28 hari berturut-turut.

5. Kanada: target 150.000 pelajar baru per tahun (2027-2029) Diumumkan

Rencana Tingkat Imigrasi 2027-2029 menetapkan 150.000 kedatangan pelajar internasional baru per tahun (2026: 155.000). Program pascasarjana tetap menjadi prioritas.

6. Amerika Serikat: aturan pengganti D/S dibatalkan pengadilan Berubah

Pada 16 November 2026 pengadilan federal Massachusetts membatalkan aturan DHS yang mengganti Duration of Status (D/S) dengan masa tinggal tetap. D/S tetap berlaku untuk sementara; pemerintah diperkirakan banding.

Untuk siswa: langkah berikutnya

  • Bandingkan biaya studi, OSHC, dan simulasi rekening koran di pricelist Talented.
  • Ikuti tab Berita Imigrasi untuk ringkasan resmi terbaru dalam 15 bahasa.
  • Konsultasi gratis lewat linktr.ee/talentededucationgroup.

Untuk institusi pendidikan

Calon siswa Indonesia & Asia Tenggara membandingkan biaya studi di website Talented dalam 15 bahasa. Ingin program Anda tampil sebagai Sponsored? Ajukan paket promosi.
body.en:
This month brings several official changes (and one public consultation) that matter for students planning to study overseas in 2027. Every point below comes from government websites - see Sources.

1. Australia: Genuine Student & financial capacity consultation Public consultation

Home Affairs is consulting (closes 23 November 2026) on updating Ministerial Direction 106 for the Genuine Student assessment, strengthening financial capacity requirements, and a possible interim measure for Evidence Level 3 applicants. No decisions have been made - current rules still apply.

What it means for you: prepare clear financial documents and a well-explained study plan early. Talented's price list already estimates the minimum bank statement for every programme.

2. New Zealand: Short-Term Graduate Work Visa (6 months) In force

From 16 November 2026, graduates of NZQCF Level 5-7 qualifications (at least 24 weeks full-time in NZ) who are not eligible for a Post-Study Work Visa can get 6 months of open work rights. Apply within 3 months of your student visa expiring and show NZD 5,000 in living funds.

3. New Zealand: Post-Study Work Visa eligibility extended In force

Also from 16 November 2026: Level 7 Graduate Diploma graduates who already hold a bachelor's degree (NZ or overseas) can get a PSWV of up to 1 year. Postgraduate Diploma (Level 8) up to 1 year and Master's (Level 9) up to 3 years, with at least 30 weeks of full-time study in NZ.

4. UK: maintenance funds rise on 30 November 2026 Upcoming

For Student visa applications from 30 November 2026: London GBP 1,570/month (max. 9 months = GBP 14,130) and outside London GBP 1,203/month (max. GBP 10,827). Funds must be held for 28 consecutive days.

5. Canada: 150,000 new students per year (2027-2029) Announced

The 2027-2029 Immigration Levels Plan sets 150,000 new international student arrivals per year (2026: 155,000). Postgraduate study remains a priority.

6. United States: court vacates the rule replacing D/S Changed

On 16 November 2026 a Massachusetts federal court vacated the DHS rule that replaced Duration of Status (D/S) with fixed admission periods. D/S remains for now; an appeal is expected.

For students: next steps

  • Compare study costs, OSHC and bank statement estimates on the Talented price list.
  • Follow the Immigration News tab for official summaries in 15 languages.
  • Free consultation: linktr.ee/talentededucationgroup.

For education providers

Students from Indonesia & Southeast Asia compare study costs on Talented's website in 15 languages. Want your programmes featured as Sponsored? Apply for a promotion package.
